# CANDIDATE: WEEKLY_DTE_NOT_0DTE_WEEKLY1_GATE

**Filed:** 2026-09-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** filter_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Requiring a weekly-1 timeframe confirmation signal for ITM-2 strike entries (1-2 DTE weekly options) will filter out false signals and improve edge capture by reducing losses on loser days while preserving winners. The weekly-1 signal is defined as the prior weekly bar's close being in the same direction as the intended trade (put: weekly close < weekly open; call: weekly close > weekly open).

## Mechanism

For ITM-2 strike entries (1-2 DTE weekly options), entry is allowed only if the weekly-1 bar (the bar from the previous week at the same time of day) shows directional confirmation: weekly close < weekly open for put entries, weekly close > weekly open for call entries. All other trigger logic, exit (-8%/+30%), and position sizing remain unchanged. The gate is applied as a pre-entry filter.
